project.name: Shop API
project.description: Sample e-commerce orders API used as the demo target of apidocs.

endpoints.description: Lists orders, newest first, optionally filtered by status.
Lists every order of a customer. Deprecated: use the paginated listing instead.

schemas.name: CreateOrderRequest
schemas.description: Items to buy for an existing customer.

schemas.name: CreateProductRequest
schemas.description: Data required to register a new product in the catalog.

schemas.name: PageResponse_OrderResponse
schemas.description: Page of results returned by list endpoints.

schemas.name: StockAdjustmentRequest
schemas.description: Relative stock change; negative values remove units.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Registers a customer; e-mail addresses are unique.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an order for an existing customer, reserving stock for every item. Orders above 500.00 receive a 10% discount.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: PageResponse<OrderResponse> list(OrderStatus status, int page, int size)

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an order and returns its items to stock. Shipped or delivered orders cannot be cancelled.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Moves an order forward: CREATED to PAID to SHIPPED to DELIVERED.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an order; only cancelled orders can be deleted.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Registers a product; SKUs are unique across the catalog.

methods.name: adjustStock
methods.description: Applies a relative stock change; stock can never become negative.
